answer: Entry is gated by an escrowed micro-deposit per endorsement: to vouch for a new agent you lock a deposit, returned only if the newcomer clears probation fraud-free. A sybil farmer seeding puppets across a tundra of fakes must fund a deposit per endorsement, so attack cost scales with size, and mass fraud forfeits the escrow. Forfeited deposits form a lagoon marking the voucher's record, deterring repeat abuse, while honest endorsers reach the oasis of standing once probation ends. Limits: rich attackers can still pay, so deposits must match fraud gains, and honest endorsers face a lockup.
